top_choice_rationale: P001 (B036: Crews, Deshaies, Handa) is the only proposal where the structure and mechanism are actually determined: VHL and cereblon ternary-complex crystal structures explain selectivity and cooperativity, cereblon was identified as the thalidomide target, and degradation kinetics are measured quantitatively and reproduced across many laboratories. Induced proximity to an E3 ligase is a transferable design principle that reaches targets without druggable pockets. The three names mark the originating discoveries for the two halves of one principle; Ciulli's refinement is a real cost of the three-name limit but not the originating discovery. P002 (B034 C-N coupling) is mature and cleanly attributed but follows the 2010 palladium cross-coupling prize and reads as refinement of an honoured paradigm, so it ranks second, ahead of no award.
recusal_note: No direct conflict apparent from profile with Crews, Deshaies, Handa, Buchwald or Hartwig; she is a Stockholm University colleague of Secretary Peter Brzezinski, but he is not a nominee.
